Synopsis:
    Reuters piece on growing Russian civilian anxiety ahead of parliamentary elections (Sep 18-20 2026), driven by Ukrainian drone strikes reaching deep into Russian territory. Key signals: rising demand for blast-protective film and drone-strike insurance, fear of renewed military mobilisation post-election, and sustained high anxiety readings in state polling. The Kremlin is escalating air attacks on Ukraine in response. Conflict appears to be entering a more intense phase with no near-term negotiation in sight.
